title: Prime Minister offers prayers to Maa Kushmanda during Navratri
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has offered prayers to Maa Kushmanda, the fourth form of Goddess Durga, during Navratri.
The Prime Minister wished that her boundless energy bring new hope, happiness, prosperity and good health into the lives of all citizens.
Shri Modi wrote on X;
“नवरात्रि में आज देवी माता के चौथे स्वरूप मां कूष्मांडा की पूजा का विधान है। उनकी असीम ऊर्जा से समस्त देशवासियों के जीवन में नई आशा, सुख-समृद्धि एवं आरोग्य का संचार हो।”
